The title names National Wrapper Redemption (CF-BOWMAN-NSCC-IS-ITS-OWN-PRODUCT) and Black Prism Refractor, but the row is stored on flagship bowman-chrome with parallel="Prism Refractor" — the wrapper-redemption product and the BLACK of the parallel were both dropped, so a 1/1 NSCC sale prices the flagship Prism pool. Verified live read-only 2026-09-01: the row still sits at fromCardId with that exact title and price 2200; NO document with this id exists at the destination partition (the destination partition holds ZERO rows, and a cross-partition sweep on this id returns exactly ONE document, the source) — so this is a relocate, not a V-01 duplicate-pair exclusion; the destination catalog row EXISTS (id/hobbyiqCardId hiq:baseball:2019:bowman-chrome-nscc:bnr-vgj:black-prism-refractor:no-auto:num-1, source cardpedia-drew-ruling-2026-09-01, parallel "Black Prism Refractor", printRun 1, cardNumber BNR-VGJ, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. — the drew-ruled NSCC ladder's 1/1). GRADE: the title states BGS GEM MINT 9.5 while the stored grade fields (gradeCompany, gradeValue, gradeQualifier) are all EMPTY. That is left alone — census picks up the grade; this lane moves identity only. The title-exclusivity lane (repair-setkey-from-title-parallel) provably cannot reach this row. Scoped report-only run 2026-09-01, SPORTS=baseball YEARS=2018,2019 SETKEYS=bowman-chrome: scanned 15,195, MOVES 0, wrote 0 (refusals: sameProduct 3,746; notExclusive 445; noDest 29; lot 13; noTitleProduct 0; wrongCard 0). This row lands in the sameProduct bucket, confirmed directly against the built parser: inferSetKeyFromTitle(title) = "Bowman Chrome" -> normalizeSetKey -> "bowman-chrome", which IS the row's current setKey, so the lane has no opinion and refuses. "National Wrapper Redemption" is invisible to the title-product vocabulary, and the same parser returns parallel "Prism Refractor" (printRun 1, cardNumber BNR-VGJ) — dropping BLACK — which is how the row acquired its wrong parallel to begin with. No automated lane reaches it; hence a hand-verified list entry.
